text: Completed unified surface backend admission and benchmark matrix. Added versioned plan/backend/capability/resource/timing ADTs; exact admission validation; 14 semantic cases; observed adapters for deterministic raster, JavaFX Scene3D, and Three.js; shared exact 32,768/163,842 vertex x 1/4/8 layer fixtures; all eight cold/camera/style/data/timepoint/pick/resize/snapshot paths; deterministic v1 JSON receipts with runtime/graphics metadata; CPU and JavaFX live runners; real-browser exported Three.js runner; focused aliases and benchmark documentation. Evidence: sbt surfaceViewConformance passes 70 tests across surface-view JVM+JS (19+19), raster JVM+JS (8+8), JavaFX JVM (10), Three.js JS (6), warning-clean. Live raster 48/48 and JavaFX 48/48 completed. Real Chrome 150/WebGL2 matrix completed 48/48 with zero structural violations; browser harness initially exposed six pick misses caused by the fixture camera being inside the surface, corrected to an external perspective camera, then all six 32k/164k x 1/4/8 pick cases passed. Observed maxima in the one-sample browser admission run: cold 19.3 ms, camera 0.2 ms, style 1.4 ms, data 7.8 ms, timepoint 8.4 ms, pick 15.4 ms, resize 4.8 ms, snapshot 6.8 ms; these are device-specific admission observations, not baselines.
